style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontSize=11;" value="The invariant

Plane 5 is asynchronous and optional. A provider outage, throttling, graph unavailability or budget exhaustion must never block Planes 1 to 3 or add an availability dependency to them. The 50k events/sec target belongs to deterministic streaming and is never a claim about LLM throughput.

div.div:
The invariant
Plane 5 is asynchronous and optional. A provider outage, throttling, graph unavailability or budget exhaustion must never block Planes 1 to 3 or add an availability dependency to them. The 50k events/sec target belongs to deterministic streaming and is never a claim about LLM throughput.
The build enforces the structural half: no ingestion, streaming or audit module may depend on an agent module, on Neo4j, or on an LLM provider.
